positiveFlows.title: GENERATING DEEP SAVINGS AND STRONG RESILIENCE FOR VULNERABLE HOUSEHOLDS IN PUERTO RICO WITH HIGHLY COST-EFFECTIVE SOLAR + STORAGE. THE OBJECTIVE OF THE PROJECT FOR TOPIC AREA 1 IS TO EFFICIENTLY UTILIZE FUNDING FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY GRID DEPLOYMENT OFFICE PUERTO RICO ENERGY RESILIENCE FUND TO RAPIDLY DEPLOY ROOFTOP SOLAR PV AND BATTERY STORAGE SYSTEMS TO THE HOMES OF ELIGIBLE RESIDENTS (BENEFICIARIES) TO INCREASE THEIR ENERGY RESILIENCE AND DECREASE THEIR ENERGY BURDEN, GROW THE CLEAN ENERGY WORKFORCE IN PUERTO RICO, AND PROVIDE EDUCATION AND TRAINING FOR BOTH RESIDENTS AND WORKERS. TOPIC AREA 1 REQUIRES NO LESS THAN 5% COST SHARE FOR EACH PHASE OF WORK.

SUNNOVA ENERGY RESILIENCY ACCELERATOR (SERA)

THE U.S. DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY (DOE) GRID DEPLOYMENT OFFICE (GDO) ESTABLISHED THE PUERTO RICO ENERGY RESILIENCE FUND (PR-ERF) TO ADMINISTER A PROGRAM FOCUSED ON BOTH RESIDENTIAL AND COMMUNITY-BASED ENERGY RESILIENCE INVESTMENTS, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC (PV) AND BATTERY STORAGE DEPLOYMENTS, AS WELL AS COMMUNITY PARTNERSHIPS AND OTHER ACTIVITIES TO GROW PUERTO RICO’S CLEAN ENERGY ECONOMY.
SOLAR HOMES PROGRAM PUERTO RICO

ENERGY RESILIENCY EDUCATION, TRAINING, AND CONSUMER PROTECTION FOR PUERTO RICO.  THIS COOPERATIVE AGREEMENT SUPPORTS THE PUERTO RICO ENERGY RESILIENCE FUND (PR-ERF) TO ADMINISTER A PROGRAM FOCUSED ON RESIDENTIAL AND COMMUNITY-BASED ENERGY RESILIENCE INVESTMENTS, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC (PV) AND BATTERY STORAGE DEPLOYMENTS, AS WELL AS COMMUNITY PARTNERSHIPS AND OTHER ACTIVITIES TO GROW PUERTO RICO'S CLEAN ENERGY ECONOMY.  THE RECIPIENT WILL FOCUS ON BENEFICIARY EDUCATION, COMMUNITY PARTNERSHIP, AND MASS MEDIA CAMPAIGNS OF RESIDENTIAL SOLAR PV AND BATTERY STORAGE DEPLOYMENTS.  ALTHOUGH THE RECIPIENT WILL NOT BE RESPONSIBLE FOR CONSUMER PROTECTION SERVICES, THEY WILL LEVERAGE THEIR EDUCATION AND OUTREACH ROLE TO INTEGRATE BASIC EDUCATION AND ORIENTATION TO BENEFICIARIES ON CONSUMER PROTECTION RIGHTS AND REFERRALS TO AVAILABLE PROTECTION SERVICES.  THIS AGREEMENT WILL BE EXECUTED IN TWO PHASES.  PHASE 1 IS TO DEVELOP A DETAILED PROJECT PLAN.  FOLLOWING A SUCCESSFUL GO/NO-GO DECISION, THE RECIPIENT WILL ENTER THE IMPLEMENTATION PHASE 2, AND BEGIN EXECUTING THE PROJECT PLAN.  THE RECIPIENT WILL BE EVALUATED EACH TWELVE MONTHS TO ENSURE GOALS OF THE PROJECT PLAN ARE BEING MET.
PEOPLE’S AGGREGATED RESILIENCE AND GENERATION TO ENHANCE LOCAL ECONOMIES - PARA LA GENTE

PROVIDING RESILIENT AND AFFORDABLE SOLAR ENERGY FOR THE MAJORITY OF VERY LOW-INCOME SINGLE-FAMILY HOUSEHOLDS IN CULEBRA, PUERTO RICO

THE PROJECT OBJECTIVE IS TO DEPLOY RESIDENTIAL SOLAR PV AND BATTERY STORAGE INSTALLATIONS, USING COMMERCIALLY AVAILABLE TECHNOLOGY, TO ENHANCE RESILIENCE AND PROVIDE OTHER BENEFITS.

COMMUNITY-BASED MODEL TO BRING SOLAR VULNERABLE HOUSEHOLDS IN PUERTO RICO

LET’S SHARE THE SUN SEEKS ACCELERATE LOCAL OWNERSHIP OF RESILIENT SOLAR SYSTEMS AND LOCAL WEALTH CREATION WITH PUERTO RICAN SOLAR FIRMS, LEVERAGING COMMUNITY-BASED PHILANTHROPIC MODEL ALONG WITH A NON-PROFIT THIRD-PARTY FINANCE MODEL TO ACHIEVE SCALE AND ENSURE THAT ALL MEMBERS OF A COMMUNITY ARE SERVED WITH RELIABLE AND AFFORDABLE ENERGY - EVEN THOSE MOST VULNERABLE AND HARD-TO-REACH LAST-MILE COMMUNITIES. LSTS SEEKS TO REACH 500 HOMES WITH CONSTRUCTION COMPLETED BY LOCAL INSTALLATION COMPANIES IN PUERTO RICO.
AWARD OF CONTRACT TO MANAGE AND OPERATE THE NATIONAL RENEWABLE ENERGY LABORATORY

SOLAR HOMEOWNER INFORMATION, NEEDS & EDUCATION (SHINE).  THIS COOPERATIVE AGREEMENT SUPPORTS THE PUERTO RICO ENERGY RESILIENCE FUND (PR-ERF) TO ADMINISTER A PROGRAM FOCUSED ON RESIDENTIAL AND COMMUNITY-BASED ENERGY RESILIENCE INVESTMENTS, INCLUDING BUT NOT LIMITED TO SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC (PV) AND BATTERY STORAGE DEPLOYMENTS, AS WELL AS COMMUNITY PARTNERSHIPS AND OTHER ACTIVITIES TO GROW PUERTO RICO’S CLEAN ENERGY ECONOMY.  THE RECIPIENT WILL WORK WITH DOE TO PROVIDE PROACTIVE CONSUMER PROTECTION (ADDRESSING ROOT CAUSES OF INSTALL ISSUES) WITH A FOCUS ON INSTALLER-FACING QUALITY ASSURANCE/QUALITY CONTROL AND WILL BE EXECUTED IN TWO PHASES.  PHASE 1 IS TO DEVELOP A DETAILED PROJECT PLAN.  FOLLOWING A SUCCESSFUL GO/NO-GO DECISION, THE RECIPIENT WILL ENTER THE IMPLEMENTATION PHASE 2, AND BEGIN EXECUTING THE PROJECT PLAN.  THE RECIPIENT WILL BE EVALUATED EACH TWELVE MONTHS TO ENSURE PROJECT GOALS ARE BEING MET.  IN ADDITION TO IDENTIFYING OPPORTUNITIES FOR COORDINATION AND EFFICIENCY, THE RECIPIENT WILL PLAY A CONSUMER PROTECTION ROLE TO SUPPORT AND HELP RESOLVE BENEFICIARIES’ NEEDS RELATED TO SYSTEM PERFORMANCE, MAINTENANCE, REPAIR, AND OTHERS, BEFORE, DURING, AND AFTER INSTALLATION.  THE RECIPIENT MAY ALSO DEVELOP PROTOCOLS TO ASSIST THE BENEFICIARIES TO RESOLVE ISSUES.
